apps.name: Husk
apps.subtitle: Android app launcher for iOS
apps.localizedDescription: Run Android apps on iOS: drop in an APK, tap it, and the Android app opens full-screen on a QEMU guest with hardware-accelerated display and audio. Needs JIT plus a debugger attached at runtime, so it requires a sideloading setup that can provide get-task-allow rather than a plain re-sign.

versions.localizedDescription:
## What’s new?
* Built-in StikJIT: pair on the device and enable JIT without a second app by @danperks in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/37
* Wi-Fi support for all games
* UI Revamp: Now fully built with Swift
* Moved Translation layer to the main 4 tabs, replacing the Discover tab
## New game support
* Beach Buggy Racing 2 - 60 FPS
## New Contributors
* @danperks made their first contribution in https://github.com/Leviidev/Husk/pull/37
